r1-scope.label: Geltung
r1-scope.meaning: Holo stage and hero preview get base look + states; the Codex landing holotable gets the base look only. 2D schema views are out.

r1-target.label: Klickziel
r1-target.meaning: The part itself takes hover and click, with an invisible minimum hit area.

r1-touch.label: Erster Tipp
r1-touch.meaning: The first tap selects at once.

r1-deselect.label: Rückwege
r1-deselect.note: kein sichtbares x an der auswhal bitte
r1-deselect.meaning: Click on empty space, the panel's back control, Escape and a second click on the selected part clear the selection. No visible close cross at the selection.

r1-after.label: Panel nach Abwahl
r1-after.meaning: After deselecting, the side panel shows the list of all parts, as today.

r1-spin.label: Drehung
r1-spin.meaning: The turntable holds while the pointer is over the model and while a part is selected.
